subject.title: Feature Request: Add Charm Hyper (hyper.charm.land) as a provider

question: Should CodexBar add Charm Hyper now as an API-key balance-only provider, or defer it until reset/plan information is available through a supported data source?
rationale: The issue documents a feasible narrow probe and a more invasive dashboard-cookie path, but choosing the supported product boundary and operational cost is maintainer intent rather than a purely technical conclusion.

options.title: Accept a balance-only v1
options.body: Add a provider-local API-key credit-balance probe and document that reset and plan information are unavailable for now.

options.title: Defer for fuller account data
options.body: Wait for Charm to provide stable API access to reset or plan information before adding the provider.

recommendation.title: Accept a balance-only v1
recommendation.body: Add a provider-local API-key credit-balance probe and document that reset and plan information are unavailable for now.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available decision route for the provider-support boundary.
